name: OPB
access_notes: Publisher advertises Local News Headlines RSS. Terms permit personal noncommercial downloads and restrict public/commercial reuse. Local attributed evidence summaries only; no publication permission assumed. No full article bodies or full-content fields.

name: Willamette Week
access_notes: Public publisher-hosted RSS tested. Often brief descriptions: label limited context. Do not fetch paywalled article bodies; no license presumed for republication.

name: Portland Mercury
access_notes: Publisher-hosted RSS tested. Terms say site and feed content is for personal noncommercial use, not further dissemination. This build stays local/private. Strip full-content fields and shorten descriptions. Public reuse is not cleared.

name: KGW
jurisdiction: Portland region; direct local relevance required
access_notes: RSS endpoint responds, but terms at /terms prohibit automated requests/scraping absent an applicable exception. Disabled pending permission/clarification; do not assume RSS overrides the terms.

name: KOIN
access_notes: Public Portland-category RSS tested. Article bodies and terms endpoint returned HTTP 403; no bypass. Use only accessible feed descriptions with limited-context labels; public reuse/AI-specific terms unresolved.

name: KPTV
jurisdiction: Portland region; direct local relevance required
access_notes: Terms prohibit automated collection and using station content as input for AI/ML without express written consent. Disabled; technical feed availability is not permission.

name: City of Portland
access_notes: Official RSS discovered through alternate link on /news. Attribution identifies city announcements; claims are not independently verified. No meeting processing.

name: Multnomah County
access_notes: Official HTML news cards with heading links and machine-readable times. No feed assumed. Listing has headlines only; candidates with insufficient evidence are skipped. No meeting or public-record mining.

name: The Oregonian / OregonLive
access_notes: Candidate only. Disabled until a legitimate current feed or permitted endpoint and terms are verified. No paywall bypass.
